transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Dora, your clinical conversational agent. I can help you with questions about your cataract surgery recovery. Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. Firstly, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, such as gardening, 1 week after surgery. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you. I also wanted to ask, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops or gels before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it's safe to continue using them, unless you've been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's good to know, thank you. I've noticed that I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we'd recommend just wearing sunglasses when you go outside. However, if you have significant pain when it's bright or severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is also red and painful, we may need to assess this further. Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I am wondering if I should still have some blurriness by now.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation, but it should improve quickly. If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I had. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. Just to confirm, have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, you've answered all of my questions. Thank you again!

verdict.label: fail
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` in turn 6 by stating, "It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses." However, the agent was interrupted and did not convey `escalation_criteria` or `mild_case_advice`.
